concept.first: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-resolution production-oriented concept board for 日蹦 DayPop, an existing Traditional-Chinese mobile-first personal and shared calendar PWA, restyled as a coherent WHITE, BLACK INK and VERMILION RED MANGA JOURNAL WORKSPACE. Use both provided actual screenshots as strict structure and brand references. This is a real calendar tool, never a marketing page or dashboard. The board must show THREE COMPLETE readable app screens side by side, each preserving approximately 390x844 mobile proportions and full bottom controls: (1) existing month calendar exactly like reference 1: 2026年10月, 今天, search icon, 月/週/列表 segmented control, quick-add, seven-column date grid, plus FAB, existing small cat helper, bottom 日曆/搜尋/綜覽/設定; (2) scrolled settings like reference 2 with native quiet cards for 顯示與時區, 帳號與資料, 家庭群組, 日曆分享 and actual actions; (3) native bottom-sheet 新增行程 with 取消/儲存, 標題, 日曆, 全天, 日期, 開始/結束, 重複, 地點, 時區, 備註, fully usable fields and all bottom controls visible. Surround the screens with a coordinated but restrained desktop environment of an illustrator's manga journal work desk, large intentional negative space around the product, paper corners and two red tape accents at the outside edges only. This is the mood for a wide desktop background; keep the existing desktop phone preview model, no new sidebar. The theme must visibly extend through the header, month grid paper, settings card edges, form work surface, bottom navigation and gaps, rather than adding a banner. Signature language: crisp 3px ink outlines, restrained offset black shadows, white paper cut edges, very faint pencil/halftone texture, red tape and narrow red ruling at margins. Reading surfaces remain true white #ffffff, not cream/ivory/beige, with near-black #111111 text, muted #555555, red #e4002b primary actions. Dense calendar numbers and form text must remain clean; all decoration outside the reading area or confined to very faint edge detail. Existing typography personality Bangers for Latin numbers/headings with readable Noto Sans TC for Chinese body, preserve current icon meanings and weights, preserve real calendar colors and yellow today. Use a distinct narrow artwork treatment for navigation and header, not the same picture repeated everywhere. No new hero, slogan, explanatory theme section, fake metrics, extra navigation, floating decorative content cards, sticky notes containing new copy or made-up events. No image-based text or buttons in final implementation; this is only the concept spec, production art will be generated separately. All controls must be practical HTML/CSS/React, with a low-cost static texture system and no continuous animation. Show the complete app surfaces including lower content, not cropped top-only headers.
concept.refinement: Use case: ui-mockup. Refine ONLY the integration of generated manga-journal material INSIDE the three existing DayPop app screens in this concept, preserving the exact phone geometry, layout, Chinese copy, navigation, month grid anatomy, buttons, cat, and surrounding monochrome red-accent desk. The current board puts almost all illustration outside the app and leaves the internal surfaces too plain. Make the app itself feel like a crafted manga journal with these restrained but clearly visible recurring materials: a separate illustrated HALFTONE/INK PAGE-EDGE STRIP integrated into each header behind native text (keep central/title zone white and all controls legible); fine WHITE FIBROUS PAPER visible in calendar cells and card work surfaces, with narrow graphite double-edge shadows at card margins rather than a noisy wallpaper; a distinct BOUND PAGE MARGIN at the left/right content gutters on long settings and agenda pages; and a RED TAPE + INK HATCHING motif confined to the very top/outer corners of bottom navigation, selected tab marked by an ink-framed red underline. The red tape should look like the material holding the journal surface together, not floating stickers on controls. Preserve real white #ffffff reading space, #111111 text, red #e4002b action fills, original calendar yellow today and event colors. Do not put texture over text or give every component the same repeated picture. Cards and the event form must visibly share paper material and inked edges with the header/nav while retaining their existing semantic outlines and original control spacing. Existing native form fields from the actual project win over invented dropdown redesigns; keep minimal rectangular native inputs and actual labels. No new section, title, caption, slogan, fake event, new label, banner, or extra navigation. Produce one complete, readable three-screen board including the full footer and full form continuation, never header-only. This is a visual reference only; all real text and controls remain React, and separate no-text production assets will be generated afterward.
concept.scope: Agent-selected direction under direct implementation request; original app copy, layout and pet remain canonical.

assets.prompt: Production raster asset for the DayPop manga-journal calendar theme. Cohesive editorial hand-inked Japanese manga stationery aesthetic: true neutral white paper, charcoal #111111 linework, restrained neutral grey hatching, vivid vermilion #e4002b washi tape accents. Sharp printlike lines, fine restrained halftone, soft physical paper edge shadows, handmade but refined, not distressed/grungy. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI, controls, screens, grids that resemble a calendar, or characters/animals. Existing UI and cat are rendered separately in React. Image must be a reusable background layer, never a complete app screenshot. Asset type: desktop surrounding environment, wide landscape 1536x1024. Overhead artist's white paper journal desk. Keep the middle 62% of the canvas completely open true white with extremely faint paper grain for a 404x824 app phone preview to sit on; no objects may enter that central reading corridor. Only at the extreme left edge a partially cropped black spiral sketchbook, tiny red tape on its upper corner, ruled pencil construction marks, a black-and-red fountain pen near bottom-left. Only at extreme right edge a cropped monochrome coffee cup rim at top and a single red/black pen near lower-right, all intentionally cut by the outer canvas, sparse not a flatlay full of objects. Very small red tape fragment top-right. Edges may have light fine graphite hatching; middle is clean. All warm/cool grey shading neutral, no cream, no brown wood, no photorealism, no dramatic vignettes. No device, no phone, no drawn app. Overall quiet asymmetrical left/right balance around one central phone.

darkMode.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Create the DARK MODE companion of this exact manga-journal desktop environment asset. Change only the paper/background palette and the ink drawing's night visibility; preserve the exact object identities, their positions and cropped framing, the big completely empty central corridor, scale, red tape, spiral notebook, coffee rim and two pens. The middle clean reading corridor must be uniform neutral charcoal #171719 with only extremely faint graphite paper grain. The white drawing paper and white surrounding desk become neutral dark graphite/charcoal; their ink edges become restrained medium/light neutral grey so the sparse hand-drawn manga objects remain visible without glowing. Vermilion tape and pen accents become #ff2d4b. This is a calm night desk, not a harsh photographic negative: no neon, bloom, gradients behind the main product, no bright white surfaces, no blue or purple tint, no sepia. Do NOT add a device, text, logos, people, animals, stars, new objects, UI, buttons, or content to the center. Maintain the original landscape composition 1536x1024, sharp refined ink strokes and delicate hatching. Output an opaque complete background, not transparent.
